header.title: Container
header.description: Centered page shell with a max-width token and horizontal padding that steps up at the sm, md and lg breakpoints. Use `size` for the cap, `maxWidth` for a one-off CSS length, `fluid` to drop the cap and `padded={false}` to flush it to the edges.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Tweak the props and see the result and code instantly. The pale band is the available width; the dashed box is the content.
playground.boxBody: The dashed box is the content. The pale band behind it is the available width.

base.title: Base
base.description: By default it uses `size="lg"` (64rem), centers itself and adds horizontal padding. The examples use this box and these demo styles to show the content area.

texts.title: Page container
texts.body: The dashed box is the content. The pale band behind it is the available width. Padding grows at 640px, 768px and 1024px.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` picks the max-width token: sm (40rem), md (48rem), lg (64rem), xl (80rem) and 2xl (96rem). Sizes wider than the demo fill the space; widen the window to see each cap.

customMaxWidth.title: Custom max width
customMaxWidth.description: `maxWidth` takes precedence over `size` and `fluid`. A number is pixels; a string is any CSS length.
customMaxWidth.body: Custom cap with the same breakpoint padding as the tokens.

fluid.title: Fluid
fluid.description: `fluid` drops the max width to fill the parent. Horizontal padding stays.

texts.title: Fluid
texts.body: No max width. Horizontal padding still follows the breakpoint scale unless padded is false.

flush.title: No padding
flush.description: `padded={false}` removes the horizontal padding. The max width still applies.

texts.title: Flush
texts.body: The max width stays. Edge padding is removed.

landmark.title: Landmark
landmark.description: `as` renders main, section, article, header, footer or aside instead of a div. A section needs an accessible name, so the example passes `aria-label`.

texts.title: Featured section
texts.body: Use as to render main, section, article or other landmarks.

responsive.title: Breakpoint padding
responsive.description: Horizontal padding depends on the window width, not the parent container. Resize the window to see the value in the box change.

texts.title: Current padding
texts.body: Compact on mobile, grows on tablet and uses the largest margin from 1024px.

tailwind.articleBody: 36rem cap, space-8 padding and vertical padding with cn() on className.
tailwind.mergedBody: A 24rem cap and py-0 replace the base values thanks to tailwind-merge.

cva.body: Width and gutter variants that redefine the container variables.

css.cardBody: Border, background and vertical padding; horizontal padding grows from 1024px.

header.title: Container API
header.description: API reference for the Container React component: props, CSS classes, CSS variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath to load only this component.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: It accepts HTML attributes (HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>) and passes them to the root element. ref reaches the element so you can measure it. With maxWidth, the value is added to style as --gem-container-max.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.landmark: With as you pick a semantic landmark instead of a meaningless <div>.
a11y.label: When there are several section or aside elements, name them with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.fluid: Applied with `fluid`. Removes the max width.
rules.flush: Applied with `padded={false}`. Removes the horizontal padding.
rules.start: Applied with `centered={false}`. Aligns the container to the start.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Set on the root element. Redefine them on your `className` to change the cap or padding without overriding rules.

items.--gem-container-pad: Horizontal padding. Changes per breakpoint and is 0 with `padded={false}`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: gem-system tokens used by the container. Redefine them globally to change every container.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts HTML attributes for the root element.

items.as: HTML element or landmark to render.
items.maxWidth: Custom max width. A number is pixels; a string is any CSS length. Takes precedence over `size` and `fluid`.
items.fluid: Removes the max width. Ignored with `maxWidth`.
items.centered: Centers the container with margin-inline: auto.
items.className: Extra classes for the root element.
items.classNames: Per-slot classes. `root` is added to the root element.
items.ref: Ref to the root element so you can measure it.
